anika: FYI onboarding magnet-30b-v3 (int4) — ran a longprefill stress test with stitched segments. Around 17.9k tokens we observe token-collapse to anchors and short repeated sequences. float16 baseline OK.

 tom: did you use relative kv indexing or absolute? also what rotary_base is in model metadata?

 anika: relative indexing, prefill_stride=1024, stitch=true. model metadata shows rotary_base=65536. runtime default = 10000.

 dina: that mismatch smells like gradual phase drift. small rotary scale mismatch will accumulate over long positions. Can you show KVCACHE_DEBUG around 17850-17950?

 anika: here's a tiny run command and a short debug excerpt:
```
KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 ./bin/serve --model magnet-30b-v3 --quant=int4 \
  --prefill_mode=stream --prefill_stride=1024 --stitch=true --max-tokens=20000
```
```
[17892] kv: rel->abs convert idx=17892 -> 17892
[17892] rotary_phase: 0.9991 -> 0.0002 (wrap)
[17893] out: "the" -> "the" -> repeat
```

 prateek: two quick angles: (1) stitch merger might be interpolating phase incorrectly when indices wrap at stride boundary; (2) int4 per-layer quant noise can push logits over threshold when phase is near discontinuity.

 tom: try these quick experiments: A) stitch=false B) rotary_base_override=65536 C) quant_fallback=int8. Run A/B/C in parallel to see which axis fixes it.

 anika: kicked off A/B/C. also toggled kv_index_type=absolute on one job to check rel->abs conversions.

 ci-bot: nightly_pipeline/run/1843210001 queued - magnet-30b-v3-longprefill-bisect. artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/runs/1843210001/

 prateek: if absolute fixes it, we likely have a conversion bug when relative indices cross prefill_stride boundaries. add a unit that replays rel->abs map across stride edges. if rotary_override fixes, add a metadata validation step on model load comparing runtime compiler base vs model base.

 anika: preliminary: A (no-stitch) stable to 20k. B (rotary_override=65536) reduced repeats but occasional anchors at 19.8k. C (int8) stable. absolute indexing run also reduced failures. Seems like an interaction: stitch+relative indexing + int4 amplifies small phase/scale misalignments.

 tom: actionable list: 1) add a stitch boundary assert that logs phase delta and fails CI if > eps; 2) add rel->abs conversion unit test with random stride values; 3) add a quick model-load check comparing rotary_base and warn if mismatch; 4) run int4 vs int8 parity tests on stitch path.

 prateek: i'll draft a tiny repro harness that synthesizes phase streams and runs the stitch merge locally (no GPU) so we can iterate quickly. also adding a guard to zero-pad/clip per-layer scales at merges to reduce int4 jitter.

 anika: thanks — uploading sample outputs and KVCACHE_DEBUG to ML ticket ML-4300. sample failing tail: "...brown fox jumps the the the anchor-23 anchor-23"

 tom: nice. once PRs land let's re-run the longprefill nightly for a week.

 anika: agreed. will follow up with artifacts tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
